sentences.en: I am renting a new apartment and it needs to be furnished with all of the essentials it needs, that.

sentences.en: I can't drive, but in Mexico, I just never found it very necessary. There's public transportation to get anywhere, and it's much cheaper and much faster! Here's my receipt.
sentences.tc: 我不會開車，但在墨西哥，我從來沒有覺得開車很有必要。有公共交通可以到達任何地方，而且更便宜、更快！這是我的收據。

sentences.en: I spent $614 Mexican Pesos on all of this. So, I had to walk to Bodega Aurrera. It's a grocery store in Mexico.

sentences.tc: 我有我的手提包。由於我是步行，所以我只能裝滿一手提袋的雜貨和必需品。
